candidates.title: Wireless Power Transmission for Solar Power Satellite (SPS) — NSS Workshop Paper
candidates.notes: PDF accessible (890KB). NSS Space Solar Power Workshop paper directly on WPT efficiency for SPS. Search results indicate this type of document contains DC-to-RF, rectenna, and end-to-end efficiency chain data.

candidates.title: A Comparison of a Solar Power Satellite Concept — NASA Technical Report 2014
candidates.notes: PDF accessible (1.7MB). NASA 2014 technical report comparing SPS concepts. Likely contains power transmission efficiency breakdowns and system-level efficiency data.

candidates.title: Solar Power Beaming: From Space to Earth (LLNL-TR-412782)
candidates.notes: LLNL 2009 report (A.M. Rubenchik et al.) on laser power beaming from LEO. Accessible PDF but covers laser beaming (not microwave). Relevant to laser pathway discussed in analysis but does not cover the microwave efficiency chain which is the primary SPS reference.
